question.text: Which of the following is TRUE regarding SEBI SCORES (SEBI Complaint Redress System)?

answer.text: Only investors with investments above Rs. 10 lakh can file complaints on SCORES
SCORES can only be used after filing a police complaint
It is a web-based centralised grievance system where investors can lodge, follow up and track complaints online, and it covers SEBI-registered entities including mutual funds
SCORES automatically awards monetary compensation to the investor

explanation.text: The Logic: SCORES is a web-based centralised grievance redressal system where investors lodge, follow up and track their complaints online against SEBI-registered entities, with mutual funds among the covered entities. AMC-level grievance redressal is to be completed within 21 calendar days. The Trap: SCORES is not a court — it does not by itself award monetary compensation. There is also no investment-size eligibility threshold for using SCORES. Note: Source: NISM Series V-A (Mutual Fund Distributors) workbook, pp.91-92 — SCORES as a web-based centralised grievance system covering SEBI-registered entities including mutual funds; AMC grievance redressal within 21 calendar days.
